title: Rename Mage.Client.Streaming to Mage.Client.Observer
description: The Maven module Mage.Client.Streaming should be renamed to Mage.Client.Observer to match our bridge/pilot/observer naming conventions. The streaming client acts as the observer — it spectates the game, renders the battlefield, and records video. 'Streaming' is a legacy name from when the main purpose was streaming video; 'Observer' better describes its architectural role. This involves renaming the directory, Maven artifactId, package names (mage.client.streaming -> mage.client.observer), class prefixes (StreamingMain -> ObserverMain, StreamingMageFrame -> ObserverMageFrame, StreamingGamePanel -> ObserverGamePanel, etc.), and updating all references in the Makefile, puppeteer code, CI configs, and CLAUDE.md.
